race.description: MRC Membership Black Friday Sale Hcp (Bm74)
race.comment: TRAPDOOR (12) looks a good chance fresh. He just found one too strong first up last campaign but the winner there is talented and he then came out and beat Nobler, who is early favourite in the Eclipse Stakes later on today. Proven up to a soft 7, he should run well. ESMAHLI (2) handles all conditions and is flying this time in. Soft win at Cranbourne two back then very good down the straight at Flemington, 1300m looks to suit now. BACASH (8) keeps finding one better but is racing well and proven on wet ground. He'll roll forward and give a sight. KING TUT (11) struggled at Flemington but the fresh run was good from a hopeless spot. He's much better suited up to 1300m now. SERGEANT MAJOR (3) was good fresh in the Ararat Bowl and can turn the tables on PRINCESS QUE (5) from that race with added fitness.
